meta.one_liner: Hold the strongest asset class — stocks, small caps, international, gold or bonds — and only while its 6-month return is positive.
meta.explainer_md: Gary Antonacci's 'dual momentum' combines two filters: relative momentum (own the strongest asset in the menu) and absolute momentum (only own it if its own recent return is actually positive — otherwise sit in cash). This simplified version ranks six ETFs — US large caps, Nasdaq, small caps, international stocks, gold and long bonds — by 6-month return, holds the strongest one whose return is positive, and steps aside when that holding's 6-month return turns negative. One position, no leverage, long stretches in cash during bear markets. Simplified how? The original rebalances monthly to the strongest asset; this version only switches after an exit, so it can ride one winner longer than the strict rules would.

spec.name: Dual Momentum Rotation
spec.description: Rank 6 ETFs by 6-month return; hold the strongest while its momentum is positive.
